name: Should I hire a finish contractor or a standard painter for my kitchen?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a finish contractor or a standard painter for my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a remodeling contractor offers significant advantages if your kitchen requires work beyond simple wall rolling. Kitchen updates often reveal underlying issues, such as drywall water damage behind sinks, damaged baseboards, or a desire to add crown molding and tile backsplashes alongside fresh paint. A finish contractor like HH Remodeling handles drywall patching, trim carpentry, and finish painting together under single-point accountability. If your project is strictly a fast cosmetic wall refresh without repairs or trim work, a standard painting crew may meet your immediate needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A finish contractor is best if your project involves drywall repairs, trim carpentry, or tile work alongside painting. A dedicated painter fits simple cosmetic wall refreshes.
